YShvUYrymavpSbLYz1HvIQ.zh: 巴西今年截至8/22累計報告1萬1,017例疑病例,其中537例為確定病例,為美洲疫情最高(占報告病例75%)。針對2015-16年大規模疫情⻑期追蹤顯示,當時逾3,000名嬰兒因母子垂直感染,迄今至少444名病童死亡。現年約10歲的倖存病童正浮現第二波併發症,98%倖存病童出現骨骼畸形,伴隨小兒性早熟、自閉症及神經發育遲緩等,致該族群死亡率攀升。研究顯示10年前疫情後的群體免疫力已大幅衰退,未曾暴露的新生代增加,加上仍無疫苗及快篩工具,該國未來15至20年內恐爆發新一波疫情。
YShvUYrymavpSbLYz1HvIQ.en: As of 22 August this year, Brazil has cumulatively reported 11,017 suspected cases, of which 537 are confirmed; this is the highest in the Americas, accounting for 75% of reported cases. Long-term follow-up of the large-scale outbreak in 2015–16 shows that more than 3,000 infants were infected through mother-to-child transmission at that time, and at least 444 affected children have died to date. Surviving children, now about 10 years old, are showing a second wave of complications: 98% of surviving children have skeletal malformations, accompanied by precocious puberty, autism and neurodevelopmental delay, and mortality in this group is rising. Studies show that population immunity has declined substantially a decade after the earlier outbreak and that the number of unexposed younger people has increased; with still no vaccine or rapid test tools, the country may face a new wave of outbreaks within the next 15 to 20 years.

SrZaQQj5mzmfT7JyDIYI0A.zh: 巴布亞紐幾內亞衛生部於今年7/7宣佈爆發疫情,該國8個省份自今年1月以來累計報告108例疑個案(含3例確定病例),由於該國實驗室檢驗量能不足,須送往澳洲進行檢驗,可能低估實際傳播情形。另病例地理分佈無流行病學關聯,且該國疫苗覆蓋率低,預期疫情擴散。 巴西今年截至7/31,累計報告18例確定病例,主要集中於首都聖保羅(15例)之2歲以下與20-50歲族群。此波疫情為該國獲得消除麻疹認證後,首次出現持續性本土傳播,主因為該地區為重要樞紐,且近期世界盃結束後人潮返國及7至8月學校假期等因素。該國已針對特定地區擴大疫苗接種對象為6個月至59歲族群,防止疫情向外擴散。 美洲地區疫情持續,自今年截至7/25,共17國/地區累計報告4 萬7,026例確定病例及48例死亡(CFR:0.10%),病例數較去年同期增加5倍。其中,高達97%確定病例集中於瓜地馬拉(30,040例)、墨西哥(12,233例)、美國(2,318例)及加拿大(1,107 例)。
SrZaQQj5mzmfT7JyDIYI0A.en: Papua New Guinea's Ministry of Health declared an outbreak on 7 July this year. Across 8 provinces, 108 suspected cases (including 3 confirmed) have been reported since January this year. Because the country's laboratory testing capacity is limited, samples must be sent to Australia for testing, which may underestimate the actual spread. In addition, cases are geographically dispersed with no epidemiological links, and vaccination coverage is low, so the outbreak is expected to spread. As of 31 July this year, Brazil has reported 18 confirmed measles cases, mainly in the city of São Paulo (15 cases), among children under 2 years and people aged 20 to 50 years. This is the first sustained local transmission since the country was certified as having eliminated measles. The main factors are that the area is an important hub, the return of travellers after the recently concluded World Cup, and school holidays in July and August. Brazil has expanded vaccination in specific areas to people aged 6 months to 59 years to prevent the outbreak from spreading further. Measles activity in the Region of the Americas continues. As of 25 July this year, 17 countries and territories have reported a cumulative 47,026 confirmed cases and 48 deaths (CFR: 0.10%), a five-fold increase over the same period last year. As many as 97% of confirmed cases are concentrated in Guatemala (30,040), Mexico (12,233), the United States (2,318) and Canada (1,107).

YGw3F7QHyLNCkxJiqqZu8g.zh: 巴西今年截至第28週(7/18)累積報告111萬1,023例病例,其中重症533例、死亡259例(CFR: 0.023%),病例數占全美洲的79%,每10萬人口發生率為美洲國家次高,今年疫情低於去年同期(約321 萬例)。另該國於1-5月已接種50萬人次的全球首款單劑型疫苗,因有42人產生嚴重不良反應(其中2人死亡),當局已於6月暫停該疫苗之接種。
YGw3F7QHyLNCkxJiqqZu8g.en: As of week 28 (18 July) this year, Brazil has reported 1,111,023 cases cumulatively, including 533 severe cases and 259 deaths (CFR: 0.023%). Brazil accounts for 79% of cases in the Americas, and its incidence per 100,000 population is the second-highest among countries in the Americas. Case numbers this year are lower than the same period last year (about 3.21 million cases). In addition, between January and May, 500,000 doses of the world's first single-dose dengue vaccine were administered. Because 42 people had serious adverse reactions (2 of whom died), authorities suspended vaccination with the vaccine in June.

oNFy6vx7GKnFUDLGZGmBlA.zh: 巴西東南部米納斯吉拉斯州(Minas Gerais )今年截至6/22累積報告6萬4,304例極可能病例,其中3萬6,517確診、32例死亡並有39例死亡案例仍調查中。另巴西全國今年迄今累計報告逾41萬例疑病例 ,246 例死亡 。 斯里蘭卡疫情嚴峻,今年截至7/11累計報告逾6萬7,200例病例,其中47例死亡,近期住院數從每週700餘例增加至1,000餘例,醫療量能已不堪負荷,專家推估實際感染人數可能接近20萬人,公共衛生資源嚴重不足為導致大規模疫情之主因。
oNFy6vx7GKnFUDLGZGmBlA.en: In Minas Gerais State in southeastern Brazil, 64,304 probable cases have been reported cumulatively as of 22 June this year, including 36,517 confirmed cases and 32 deaths, with 39 death cases still under investigation. Nationwide, Brazil has reported more than 410,000 suspected cases cumulatively this year, including 246 deaths. Sri Lanka's outbreak is severe. As of 11 July this year, more than 67,200 cases have been reported cumulatively, including 47 deaths. Weekly hospitalizations have risen from over 700 to more than 1,000. Health care capacity is overwhelmed, and experts estimate the actual number of infections may be close to 200,000. A serious shortage of public health resources is the main cause of this large-scale outbreak.

JRPtQ3cuaBSSmUZLJOZIpg.zh: 巴西馬托羅索州5/29報告53例確定病例(8例死亡),以50-64歲為多,致死率則以5-9歲年齡層為高,病患分布於庫亞巴(Cuiaba)等20個城市,顯示疫情有地理分布擴散且有低度社區傳播。目前正當地流行期(5-10月),當局評估今年疫情仍低於去年同期,當地疫苗覆蓋率已達98.72%,仍持續加強疫苗接種。另該國2010-2019年平均每年報告1萬8,200例病例,致死率為9.26%。
JRPtQ3cuaBSSmUZLJOZIpg.en: In Mato Grosso State, Brazil, 53 confirmed cases (8 deaths) were reported on 29 May, most among people aged 50–64. The case fatality rate is highest in the 5–9 age group. Cases are distributed across 20 cities, including Cuiabá, indicating geographic spread and low-level community transmission. The region is currently in its local epidemic season (May–October). Authorities assess that this year's outbreak is still lower than the same period last year. Local vaccination coverage has reached 98.72%, and vaccination efforts continue to be strengthened. Brazil reported an average of 18,200 cases a year in 2010–2019, with a CFR of 9.26%.

iEW_w2TlxI8XzGdu0jUQHg.zh: 剛果民主共和國(DRC)疫情更新,迄至5/31累計321例確定病例(48例死亡、6例康復),目前尚有220例待確認之疑病例。 烏干達疫情更新,迄至5/31累計9確定病例 (1例死亡),個案分布於首都坎帕拉(Kampala)及瓦基索區(Wakiso),與跨境移動與醫療照護暴露有關。 巴西報告2例疑病例,其中1例具剛果民主共和國旅遊史,經檢驗為流行性腦脊髓膜炎及瘧疾,已排除伊波拉病毒感染。
iEW_w2TlxI8XzGdu0jUQHg.en: DRC outbreak update: as of 31 May, 321 confirmed cases had been reported (48 deaths, 6 recovered), and 220 suspected cases remain pending confirmation. Uganda outbreak update: as of 31 May, 9 cumulative confirmed cases (1 death) had been reported, distributed across the capital Kampala and Wakiso District, linked to cross-border movement and healthcare exposure. Brazil reported two suspected cases; one had recent travel history to the DRC. Testing identified meningitis and malaria, and Ebola virus infection has been ruled out.

aqEjaPr05yXKllAb7USvJQ.zh: 巴西米納斯吉拉斯州截至5/25累計報告61,229例病例(29,116例確診)及23例死亡;該國今年迄今累計報告850,783例病例(197,719例確診)及153例死亡。
aqEjaPr05yXKllAb7USvJQ.en: As of 25 May, Minas Gerais State, Brazil, had reported 61,229 cumulative cases (29,116 confirmed) and 23 deaths. Nationwide, Brazil has reported 850,783 cases (197,719 confirmed) and 153 deaths so far this year.

6eIB_85kWZQUTi9tXP5T8A.zh: 剛果民主共和國(DRC)疫情更新,迄至5/30累計282例確診病例(42例死亡、2例康復),目前尚有321例待確認之疑病例。疫情主要集中在伊圖里省、北基伍與南基伍省共22個衛生區。另烏干達目前9例確診病例 (1例死亡)。 巴西當局於聖保羅與里約熱內盧監測2名伊波拉疑個案:案1為近期自DRC入境之DRC籍男性,案2為近期自烏干達入境之比利時籍男性。兩案雖已分別確診腦膜炎與瘧疾,惟尚未排除伊波拉病毒共感染之可能性,目前均已隔離並等待檢驗結果。 WHO秘書長譚德塞於5/30親赴DRC伊圖里省重災區視察,強調妥善治療可提高存活率。
6eIB_85kWZQUTi9tXP5T8A.en: DRC outbreak update: as of 30 May, 282 confirmed cases (42 deaths, 2 recovered) had been reported, and 321 suspected cases remain pending confirmation. The outbreak is concentrated in 22 health zones across Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu provinces. Uganda currently has nine confirmed cases (1 death). Brazilian authorities are monitoring two suspected Ebola cases in São Paulo and Rio de Janeiro: case 1 is a DRC national man who recently entered Brazil from the DRC, and case 2 is a Belgian man who recently entered from Uganda. Although they were diagnosed with meningitis and malaria respectively, Ebola virus co-infection has not been ruled out, and both are isolated awaiting test results. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visited the hard-hit area of Ituri Province, DRC, on 30 May and stressed that proper treatment can improve survival.

I4uf2D-5dRk3CqGf8AFTiw.zh: 巴西聖保羅州於2025-2026監測期(自2025年7月起)截至2026年5/19已報告9例確診病例及5例死亡(致死率約56%),所有確診病例皆未接種疫苗,當局已加強疫苗接種工作。
I4uf2D-5dRk3CqGf8AFTiw.en: In São Paulo State, Brazil, during the 2025–2026 surveillance period (since July 2025), 9 confirmed cases and 5 deaths (CFR about 56%) had been reported as of 19 May 2026. All confirmed cases were unvaccinated, and authorities have stepped up vaccination efforts.

SHk6ba_1a8WXhng72szpzA.zh: 阿根廷疫情更新,今年迄 4/11 累計報告 5,506 例病例,其中 831 例確診,主要分布於薩爾塔省;美洲地區累計報告病例數以巴西及玻利維亞為多。
SHk6ba_1a8WXhng72szpzA.en: Argentina's outbreak update: as of 11 April this year, 5,506 cases have been reported cumulatively, including 831 confirmed cases, mainly in Salta Province. Across the Americas, Brazil and Bolivia have reported the most cumulative cases.

V1xuQdREiddNmKqJq9U2Aw.zh: 巴西今年迄今累計報告 38,000 餘例病例及 15 例死亡,其中,西部南馬托羅索州累計逾 2,000 例確診病例及 10 例死亡。 哥斯大黎加報告今年第 3 例病例,為居住於該國西北部瓜納卡斯特省45 歲外國籍男性,依據流行病學調查,個案於潛伏期入境,屬境外移入病例。 瓜地馬拉西南部聖馬可仕省卡塔里娜於 2 月底報告 1 例確診病例,該省鄰近之墨西哥恰帕斯州於今年亦有報告病例。該國另報告 4 例疑病例,分布於埃斯昆特拉、奇基穆拉、瓜地馬拉省。評估美洲各國疫情持續上升,泛美衛生組織持續發布流行病學警示。
V1xuQdREiddNmKqJq9U2Aw.en: Brazil has reported more than 38,000 cases and 15 deaths so far this year, including more than 2,000 confirmed cases and 10 deaths cumulatively in the western state of Mato Grosso do Sul. Costa Rica reported its third case this year, a 45-year-old foreign national man residing in Guanacaste Province in the northwest of the country. Epidemiological investigation shows he entered the country during the incubation period, making it an imported case. In Catarina, San Marcos Department in the southwest of Guatemala, one confirmed case was reported at the end of February; the neighbouring Mexican state of Chiapas has also reported cases this year. Guatemala has also reported four suspected cases in Escuintla, Chiquimula and Guatemala departments. Given continued rises in case numbers across the Americas, the Pan American Health Organization (PAHO) continues to issue epidemiological alerts.

xrr80roC5ErMIg5Y4gLi1Q.zh: WHO美洲區更新流行病學報告,該區去年共計報告46,870例確定病例,低於2024年同期(66,184例),其中以美國病例數為多,共計報告28,783例確定(含疑)病例,以11-19歲年齡層為多,其次為秘魯(4,632例),另智利(3,387例)、巴西(2,682例)、墨西哥(1,596例)、阿根廷(1,210例)及哥倫比亞(1,178例)亦報告逾千例確定病例。另美國今年截至3/27已報告2,355例確定病例。
xrr80roC5ErMIg5Y4gLi1Q.en: The WHO Americas Region has updated its epidemiological report. The region reported 46,870 confirmed cases last year, lower than the 66,184 reported in the same period of 2024. The United States reported the most, with 28,783 confirmed (including suspected) cases, mainly among people aged 11–19 years. Peru followed with 4,632 cases, and Chile (3,387), Brazil (2,682), Mexico (1,596), Argentina (1,210) and Colombia (1,178) each also reported more than 1,000 confirmed cases. In addition, the United States had reported 2,355 confirmed cases so far this year as of 27 March.

Rd3a03WsX2C22qc_8wFhIA.zh: 巴西疫情更新,今年迄今累計報告11萬餘例病例(2萬餘例確診)及8例死亡,去年累計報告381萬餘例病例(145萬餘例確診)及1,793例死亡,去年病例數及死亡數均較2024年下降,該國推動疫苗接種措施,並將逐步擴大接種對象。
Rd3a03WsX2C22qc_8wFhIA.en: Brazil's epidemic update: so far this year, more than 110,000 cases have been reported cumulatively (more than 20,000 confirmed), along with 8 deaths. Last year, more than 3.81 million cases (about 1.45 million confirmed) and 1,793 deaths were reported cumulatively. Both case numbers and deaths last year declined compared with 2024. The country is promoting vaccination and will gradually expand the target groups.

LpUDgkb0MtG4iyWDrc5bEw.zh: 哥斯大黎加報告自2017年以來首例病例,為該國西部旁塔雷納斯省24歲男性居民,當局積極進行流行病學監測及病媒蚊控制,預防疾病傳播。outbreaknewstoday 1/25 蘇利南發生疫情,已報告8例病例,皆無國外旅遊史,目前正進行接觸者追蹤調查,並加強監測措施,避免疫情擴散。outbreaknewstoday 1/23 巴西西部馬托羅索州之盧卡斯市(Lucas do Rio Verde),於2025年報告1,769例病例(808例陽性),明顯高於2024年11例報告病例(9例陽性),並發現當地大部分埃及斑蚊孳生地都於住宅內,當局對此已採取相關防治措施。
LpUDgkb0MtG4iyWDrc5bEw.en: Costa Rica reported its first case since 2017: a 24-year-old male resident of Puntarenas province in the west. Authorities are carrying out active epidemiological surveillance and vector mosquito control to prevent transmission (source: Outbreak News Today, 25 January). Suriname has an outbreak with 8 reported cases, none with recent travel abroad. Contact tracing is under way, and surveillance has been strengthened to prevent spread (Outbreak News Today, 23 January). In Lucas do Rio Verde in Mato Grosso state, western Brazil, 1,769 cases (808 positive) were reported in 2025, markedly higher than the 11 cases (9 positive) reported in 2024. Most local Aedes aegypti breeding sites were found inside homes, and authorities have taken control measures.

gYe_5uWc2obD2z5ZxOktEA.zh: 巴西1/13報告2例嬰兒病例,病患約1歲,出現嘔吐、腹瀉等症狀,疑感染源為某生產商製造之嬰兒配方奶粉,受影響的產品批次亦於歐洲多國如德國、奧地利、瑞士等銷售,於臺灣販售之相關批次產品亦已預防性下架。
gYe_5uWc2obD2z5ZxOktEA.en: Brazil reported 2 infant cases on 13 January. The patients were about one year old and presented with vomiting and diarrhoea. The suspected source is infant formula from one manufacturer. The affected product batches were also sold in several European countries, including Germany, Austria and Switzerland, and related batches sold in Taiwan have been withdrawn from sale as a precaution.

e-9Lc6mNUeBDtCmjO7uwjA.zh: 巴西於夏季反覆爆發腸胃炎疫情,多處海岸景點檢出高濃度的大腸桿菌,在260個海岸監測點中,評估有35%的海灘區域不適合游泳,包含聖卡塔琳娜州(Santa Catarina)的多個觀光海灘;當局建議大雨後2天內不要游泳,並設置每日水質監測面板,呼籲旅客注意水質。
e-9Lc6mNUeBDtCmjO7uwjA.en: Brazil has experienced repeated gastroenteritis outbreaks during the summer, with high concentrations of E. coli detected at many coastal sites. Of 260 coastal monitoring sites, 35% of beach areas were assessed as unsuitable for swimming, including several popular beaches in Santa Catarina state. Authorities recommend not swimming for 2 days after heavy rain, have set up daily water-quality monitoring dashboards, and urge travellers to pay attention to water quality.

ey-aEDjotSBWGWAVyB_WNg.zh: 全球疫情更新,2025年截至12/10共41國/地區累計報告502,264例病例(208,335例確診)及186例死亡,WHO表示季節期間多個區域爆發廣泛疫情,包括先前傳播率較低或無傳播之地區,評估全球傳播風險為中。各區署疫情如下:  美洲區病例為多,該區共16國累計報告291,451例病例(110,039例確診)及141例死亡,以巴西報告243,915例病例及116例死亡為多;  東南亞區累計報告115,985例病例(7,097例確診),主要分布於印度及泰國,其中印度截至8/31累計報告108,379例疑病例及4,995例確診病例; 歐洲區累計56,986例確診病例及43例死亡,其中法國及義大利報告本土病例,另法屬留旺島累計54,555例確診病例及43例死亡,法屬馬約特島累計報告1,259例本土病例; 西太平洋區共11國/地區累計34,035例確診病例及2例死亡,其中中國累計29,497例本土確診病例,主要分布於該國廣東省25,826例; 非洲區累計報告2,211例病例(111例確診),以模里西斯共和國報告1,583例病例為多,葛摩、肯亞、塞內加爾亦報告病例; 東地中海區累計報告1,596例病例(67例確診),其中巴基斯坦及索馬利亞報告病例。
ey-aEDjotSBWGWAVyB_WNg.en: Global outbreak update: in 2025, as of 10 December, 41 countries and areas had reported 502,264 cases cumulatively (208,335 confirmed) and 186 deaths. WHO said widespread outbreaks occurred during the season in several regions, including areas where transmission had previously been low or absent, and assessed the global transmission risk as moderate. Regional situation: the Region of the Americas reported the most cases. Sixteen countries reported 291,451 cases cumulatively (110,039 confirmed) and 141 deaths, mainly Brazil with 243,915 cases and 116 deaths. The South-East Asia Region reported 115,985 cases cumulatively (7,097 confirmed), mainly in India and Thailand; India reported 108,379 suspected and 4,995 confirmed cases as of 31 August. The European Region reported 56,986 confirmed cases and 43 deaths cumulatively. France and Italy reported local cases. Separately, French Réunion reported 54,555 confirmed cases and 43 deaths cumulatively, and French Mayotte reported 1,259 local cases cumulatively. The Western Pacific Region reported 34,035 confirmed cases and 2 deaths cumulatively across 11 countries and areas; China reported 29,497 local confirmed cases, mainly 25,826 in Guangdong province. The African Region reported 2,211 cases cumulatively (111 confirmed), mainly 1,583 cases in the Republic of Mauritius; the Comoros, Kenya and Senegal also reported cases. The Eastern Mediterranean Region reported 1,596 cases cumulatively (67 confirmed), with Pakistan and Somalia reporting cases.

ZFOaPM1fli1E6evTB72w3A.zh: 全球疫情更新,今年累計報告458,840例病例及146例死亡,病例數較去年同期增加,10月報告病例數較9月增加108%,近2個月病例主要分布於美洲及亞洲。  今年美洲累計266,165例病例及118例死亡,較去年同期為低,以南美洲巴西病例數最多,其中,該國中西部和東南部地區在過去3週疫情最為嚴峻,並預期11月病例數將再度上升。 今年亞洲累計136,233例病例,較去年同期為低,以東南亞印度病例數最多;中國廣東省自7月疫情爆發以來,近期每週病例數呈下降趨勢,惟10月病例數較9月增加,香港及廣西壯族自治區亦有報告病例。 今年歐洲共2國報告病例,法國累計804例本土病例;義大利累計385例本土病例。
ZFOaPM1fli1E6evTB72w3A.en: Global update: This year, 458,840 cases and 146 deaths have been reported cumulatively, with case numbers higher than the same period last year. Reported cases in October rose 108% from September, and in the past two months cases have been mainly distributed in the Americas and Asia. The Americas have reported 266,165 cumulative cases and 118 deaths this year, lower than the same period last year. Brazil has the most cases; its central-western and south-eastern regions have been the most severely affected in the past three weeks, and case numbers are expected to rise again in November. Asia has reported 136,233 cumulative cases this year, lower than the same period last year. India has the most cases in South-East Asia. In Guangdong Province, China, weekly cases have shown a declining trend since the outbreak began in July, but October cases were higher than September. Cases have also been reported in Hong Kong and the Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region. Two European countries have reported cases this year: France has 804 cumulative locally acquired cases and Italy has 385.

qyqHHYthH4Z8OwqWzIGJ_g.zh: 巴西疫情更新,該國南部聖卡塔琳娜州今年DENV-3血清型別病例數明顯上升,該州今年迄今累計報告25,371例疑病例(17,859例確診)及20例死亡,9月報告疑病例數較前1個月增加230%,當局提醒未來幾週為高溫降雨天氣,預期病例數將會上升。
qyqHHYthH4Z8OwqWzIGJ_g.en: Brazil update: In the southern state of Santa Catarina, cases of the DENV-3 serotype have risen markedly this year. So far this year, the state has reported 25,371 cumulative suspected cases (17,859 confirmed) and 20 deaths. Suspected cases reported in September rose 230% from the previous month. Authorities warn that the coming weeks will bring high temperatures and rainfall, and case numbers are expected to rise.

adipYlJuiP6WN2m5z3Pljg.zh: 中國廣東省近期疫情呈波動下降趨勢,近1週(10/19-25)新增868例病例,以江門市199例最多,其次為佛山市130例及廣州市124例,無報告重症及死亡病例,該省近期仍處病媒蚊活躍期,持續有疫情傳播風險,江門市於10/25宣布終止突發公共衛生事件三級響應;香港報告今年首例本土病例,今年迄今累計46例移入病例。 巴西疫情更新,馬托羅索州庫亞巴今年迄今累計10,978例確診病例及27例死亡,疫情仍為該城市重要公共衛生議題。
adipYlJuiP6WN2m5z3Pljg.en: Guangdong Province, China: The outbreak shows a fluctuating downward trend. In the past week (19–25 October), 868 new cases were reported, the most in Jiangmen city (199), followed by Foshan (130) and Guangzhou (124). No severe or fatal cases were reported. The province remains in the active season for disease-carrying mosquitoes, and there is an ongoing risk of transmission. Jiangmen City announced the termination of its Level III public health emergency response on 25 October. Hong Kong reported its first locally acquired case this year; so far this year, 46 imported cases have been reported cumulatively. Brazil update: In Cuiabá, the capital of Mato Grosso state, 10,978 confirmed cases and 27 deaths have been reported cumulatively this year. The outbreak remains an important public health issue for the city.

CZ_49AJRgiEeT3xPTFR6Vw.zh: 中國廣東省疫情持續,近1週(9/28-10/4)新增3,181例病例,主要分布於江門市2,480例,其次為佛山市、廣州市及肇慶市分別新增100餘例,無報告重症及死亡病例,江門市近期疫情仍處高點波動,由於假期人潮流動、氣候等因素致疫情傳播風險持續增加,當地已啟動突發公共衛生事件三級響應,全力展開防控工作。 全球疫情持續,今年截至9/30累計40國報告445,271例病例及155例死亡,部分國家/地區於今年發生疫情,包括近幾年病例數並不多之國家/地區。全球病例分布以美洲區最多,其中,以巴西疫情最為嚴峻;歐洲區之法國及義大利報告本土病例,法國今年疫情上升與法屬留旺島及印度洋地區疫情有關,法屬留旺島/馬約特島疫情已下降;東南亞區以印度病例數為多,孟加拉、泰國及斯里蘭卡亦報告病例;西太平洋區之中國廣東省截至9/27累計16,452例確診病例,分布於21城市,以佛山市10,032例及江門市5,209例為多,為該國有紀錄以來最大規模疫情,另廣西壯族自治區於9/1-21報告297例,福建省報告124例,其他省份如湖南省、四川省、海南省亦報告病例;非洲區以模里西斯共和國病例數為多;東地中海區之巴基斯坦及索馬利亞亦報告病例。WHO建議加強監測、實驗室及醫療保健能力、病媒監控,以降低疾病進一步傳播風險。
CZ_49AJRgiEeT3xPTFR6Vw.en: Guangdong Province, China: The outbreak continues. In the past week (28 September–4 October), 3,181 new cases were reported, mainly in Jiangmen city (2,480), followed by Foshan, Guangzhou and Zhaoqing, each with more than 100 new cases. No severe or fatal cases were reported. Jiangmen's outbreak remains at a high level with fluctuations. Because of holiday population movement, weather and other factors, transmission risk continues to increase. The area has launched a Level III public health emergency response and is fully carrying out prevention and control work. Globally, the outbreak continues: as of 30 September this year, 40 countries had reported 445,271 cases and 155 deaths cumulatively. Some countries and regions had outbreaks this year, including some that had reported few cases in recent years. The Americas have the most cases globally, with Brazil the most severe. In Europe, France and Italy reported locally acquired cases. France's rise this year is linked to outbreaks in French Réunion and the Indian Ocean area, while the outbreak in French Réunion and Mayotte has declined. In South-East Asia, India has the most cases, and Bangladesh, Thailand and Sri Lanka also reported cases. In the Western Pacific, Guangdong Province, China, had reported 16,452 confirmed cases as of 27 September, distributed across 21 cities, mainly Foshan (10,032) and Jiangmen (5,209), the largest outbreak on record for the country. Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region reported 297 cases from 1 to 21 September, Fujian Province reported 124, and other provinces such as Hunan, Sichuan and Hainan also reported cases. In Africa, Mauritius has the most cases. In the Eastern Mediterranean, Pakistan and Somalia also reported cases. WHO recommends strengthening surveillance, laboratory and healthcare capacity, and vector control to reduce the risk of further spread.

dGVFCBx9AjA_6INaYURpRg.zh: 巴西米納斯吉拉斯州卡埃特9/18報告2例死亡病例,其後宣布疫情構成公共衛生緊急事件,該州今年迄今累計27例病例,主要分布於美景市5例及伊塔比拉4例;該州去年累計95例病例及4例死亡、2023年累計90例病例及20例死亡、2022年累計27例病例及6例死亡。當局提醒民眾出現發燒、頭痛、肌肉疼痛、噁心或嘔吐等疑症狀應立即就醫,並告知是否曾接觸過動物或蜱蟲。
dGVFCBx9AjA_6INaYURpRg.en: In Caeté, Minas Gerais State, Brazil, two deaths were reported on 18 September, after which the outbreak was declared a public health emergency. The state has recorded 27 cases so far this year, mainly in Belo Oriente (5 cases) and Itabira (4 cases). Last year the state recorded 95 cases and 4 deaths; in 2023, 90 cases and 20 deaths; and in 2022, 27 cases and 6 deaths. Authorities urge anyone with suspicious symptoms such as fever, headache, muscle pain, nausea or vomiting to seek medical care immediately, and to report any contact with animals or ticks.

9y0-W3DCxc9um_CMqll-rQ.zh: 巴西西北部亞馬遜州塔巴廷加報告3例病例,其中,2例男性及1例女性,該疾病係由蚊子傳播,由於該城市位於巴西與哥倫比亞及秘魯交界地區,其生物多樣性及跨國遷移可能對公共衛生造成影響,該疾病會引起大腦炎症,可能會留下包括運動、認知、行為及情緒等後遺症。
9y0-W3DCxc9um_CMqll-rQ.en: In Tabatinga, Amazonas State, north-western Brazil, three cases were reported (two men and one woman). The disease is transmitted by mosquitoes. Because the city lies on the border between Brazil, Colombia and Peru, its biodiversity and cross-border migration may affect public health. The disease causes inflammation of the brain and may leave sequelae including motor, cognitive, behavioural and emotional impairment.

0xGF5Q0WNSrT3oR8zcJtBw.zh: 美洲地區今年截至7月累計11國報告逾12,700例確診病例,其中,巴西、哥倫比亞、古巴、巴拿馬、秘魯及委內瑞拉均有報告本土病例,以往疫情主要分布於亞馬遜雨林地區,惟近2年已傳播至原流行區以外地區。泛美衛生組織(PAHO)針對美洲局部地區屈公病疫情及奧羅普切熱病例持續發生,於8/29呼籲美洲地區加強監測及病媒控制,將奧羅普切熱感染納入疑登革熱感染之鑑別診斷中,並提醒可能出現之神經系統併發症狀。
0xGF5Q0WNSrT3oR8zcJtBw.en: In the Americas, as of July this year, 11 countries had cumulatively reported more than 12,700 confirmed cases. Locally acquired cases have been reported in Brazil, Colombia, Cuba, Panama, Peru and Venezuela. Previous outbreaks were mainly in the Amazon rainforest region, but in the past two years the disease has spread beyond its original endemic areas. In view of continued chikungunya outbreaks in parts of the Americas and continued Oropouche cases, PAHO on 29 August called on the region to strengthen surveillance and vector control, to include Oropouche infection in the differential diagnosis of suspected dengue, and to be alert to possible neurological complications.

f1TBWf2QH2FqKtO5vbktgg.zh: 中國廣東省疫情趨緩,近1週(8/24-30)新增225例病例,未報告重症及死亡病例,以佛山市119例最多,其次為廣州市49例,相較於前1週新增336例,病例數呈下降趨勢,當局持續進行疫情防治工作。 全球今年截至8月中旬累計逾270,000例病例,美洲地區累計14國報告212,029例病例及110例死亡,主要分布於南美洲(玻利維亞、巴西、巴拉圭)及部分加勒比地區,此外,於印度洋、歐洲及亞洲之持續疫情,提升不同基因型共同循環之可能性,大幅增加其再度傳播及蔓延之風險。
f1TBWf2QH2FqKtO5vbktgg.en: Guangdong Province, China, has seen its outbreak ease: in the past week (24–30 August), 225 new cases were reported, with no severe or fatal cases. Foshan City had the most, with 119 cases, followed by Guangzhou City with 49. Compared with 336 new cases in the previous week, case numbers are declining. Authorities continue outbreak prevention and control work. Globally, as of mid-August this year, more than 270,000 cases had been cumulatively reported. The Americas region has cumulatively reported 212,029 cases and 110 deaths from 14 countries, mainly in South America (Bolivia, Brazil and Paraguay) and parts of the Caribbean. In addition, ongoing outbreaks in the Indian Ocean, Europe and Asia increase the likelihood of different genotypes circulating together, which greatly increases the risk of renewed transmission and spread.

jR9Nhls1xwIljgdxjXb6cA.zh: 日本今年截至7/27累計報告4例,分別為千葉縣3例及東京都1例,該病原體不存在於該國自然環境,主要發生於前往流行區之旅客,該國2012-23共計報告34例病例,其中33例為境外感染,分別自美國31例(亞利桑那州19例/加州8例)、墨西哥1例、加拉瓜1例,1例為本土病例,其曾接觸過球孢子菌樣本。病例主要以20多歲為主,並以男性為多(男性22例/女性12例);球黴菌症屬該國第四類感染症,病例必須在診斷後立即通報。 美洲之美國西南部、墨西哥北部、中美洲和南美洲部分地區為地方性流行區,除美國外,其他國家未列入正式全國監測或法定通報疾病。墨西哥感染盛行率與美國西南部相近,於2000-19年報告766例,北部乾旱州份(如索諾拉、下加州)為主要流行區;巴西與阿根廷病例逐年增加,甚至擴展至過去之非流行區,巴西於1978-2021年共計報告292例,主要來自東北部巴西皮奧伊州(Piauí )和馬拉昂州(Maranhão)。
jR9Nhls1xwIljgdxjXb6cA.en: Japan has cumulatively reported four cases this year as of 27 July: three in Chiba Prefecture and one in Tokyo Metropolis. The pathogen does not exist in Japan's natural environment, and cases occur mainly in travellers who visit endemic areas. From 2012 to 2023, Japan reported 34 cases in total, 33 of them acquired abroad: 31 from the United States (19 in Arizona and 8 in California), one from Mexico and one from Nicaragua. One case was locally acquired, in a person who had been exposed to Coccidioides specimens. Most cases are in patients in their 20s and are predominantly male (22 men and 12 women). Coccidioidomycosis is a Category IV notifiable infectious disease in Japan, and cases must be reported immediately upon diagnosis. In the Americas, the south-western United States, northern Mexico, Central America and parts of South America are endemic areas. Apart from the United States, other countries do not include the disease in formal national surveillance or statutory notification. Mexico's infection prevalence is similar to that of the south-western United States; Mexico reported 766 cases in 2000–2019, mainly in arid northern states such as Sonora and Baja California. Cases in Brazil and Argentina are increasing year by year and have even spread into previously non-endemic areas. Brazil reported 292 cases in 1978–2021, mainly from the north-eastern Brazilian states of Piauí and Maranhão.

zekEQCwJMOQXY8FKV6j3Lg.zh: 美洲疫情更新,今年截至第30週共11國累計報告12,786例確診病例,其中,巴西11,888例(5例死亡)、巴拿馬501例、秘魯330例、古巴28例、哥倫比亞26例、委內瑞拉5例、蓋亞那1例、烏拉圭3例(境外移入)、智利2例(境外移入)、美國及加拿大各1例(境外移入)。受到氣候變遷等因素導致病媒─帕拉庫蠓孳生,進而造成病毒傳播至非流行地區(如古巴市區)。此外,英國亦報告3例病例,均有巴西旅遊史。去年美洲地區累計報告16,239例確診病例(4例死亡),歐洲地區亦報告30例境外移入病例。
zekEQCwJMOQXY8FKV6j3Lg.en: Americas outbreak update: as of week 30 this year, 11 countries had cumulatively reported 12,786 confirmed cases: Brazil 11,888 (5 deaths), Panama 501, Peru 330, Cuba 28, Colombia 26, Venezuela 5, Guyana 1, Uruguay 3 (imported), Chile 2 (imported), and the USA and Canada 1 each (imported). Climate change and other factors have led to proliferation of the vector, the Culicoides paraensis midge, which has spread the virus to non-endemic areas such as central Havana, Cuba. In addition, the UK reported three cases, all with travel history to Brazil. Last year, the Americas cumulatively reported 16,239 confirmed cases (4 deaths), and Europe also reported 30 imported cases.

KpXJS-QiaNyZBxaWghEFMg.zh: 全球今年迄今累計報告逾360萬例病例及2,000例死亡,以美洲地區報告逾330萬例病例為多,其中病例主要分布於巴西;今年亞洲地區之印累計89,845例病例、馬來西亞35,348例、斯里蘭卡31,544例、越南28,787例、泰國24,372例及孟加拉20,218例;非洲地區累計10國報告9,266例病例及18例死亡。
KpXJS-QiaNyZBxaWghEFMg.en: Globally, more than 3.6 million cases and 2,000 deaths have been cumulatively reported this year, with the Americas region accounting for more than 3.3 million cases, mainly in Brazil. In Asia this year, Indonesia has cumulatively reported 89,845 cases, Malaysia 35,348, Sri Lanka 31,544, Viet Nam 28,787, Thailand 24,372 and Bangladesh 20,218. In Africa, 10 countries have reported 9,266 cases and 18 deaths cumulatively.

G8ODJkG7CYXfnzu9G7s_VA.zh: 巴西聖保羅市今年截至7/8累計報告974例病例,較去年增加90%,發生率為每10萬人口2.19,病患以20-39歲男性為主;當局表示疫苗涵蓋率較去年減少9.7%,另該國2017-18年於里約熱內盧的疫情,有超過半數為MSM族群,且與重大賽事有關。
G8ODJkG7CYXfnzu9G7s_VA.en: São Paulo city, Brazil, has reported 974 cases so far this year as of 8 July, 90% more than last year. The incidence is 2.19 per 100,000 population, and most patients are men aged 20–39. Authorities say vaccination coverage has decreased by 9.7% compared with last year. In addition, the country's 2017–18 outbreak in Rio de Janeiro involved more than half MSM and was linked to major sporting events.

TEEthy_-_aneVY0fNVJGuA.zh: 全球今年迄今累計報告約220,000例病例及80例死亡,分布於美/非/亞洲、法屬留旺島及馬約特島,其中,美洲病例數最多,以巴西141,436例及阿根廷2,521例為多,亞洲之印度、斯里蘭卡及巴基斯坦等國報告逾33,000例,非洲塞內加爾亦有報告病例,另法屬留旺島/馬約特島分別報告逾51,000例及560例,ECDC評估歐洲目前環境愈來愈利於病媒蚊活動,當地疾病傳播風險增加。
TEEthy_-_aneVY0fNVJGuA.en: Globally this year, about 220,000 cases and 80 deaths have been reported cumulatively, in the Americas, Africa and Asia, as well as in the French overseas territories of Réunion and Mayotte. The Americas have the most cases, with Brazil reporting 141,436 and Argentina 2,521. Asian countries including India, Sri Lanka and Pakistan have reported more than 33,000 cases. Senegal in Africa has also reported cases. Réunion and Mayotte have reported more than 51,000 and 560 cases, respectively. ECDC assesses that the environment in Europe is increasingly favorable for vector mosquito activity, and the risk of local transmission is increasing.

kgfiy00HE0N6tXESuY0YCg.zh: 巴西首都聖保羅市今年截至6/11,報告1,754例,其中175例死亡,相較去年同期983例病例(77例死亡)為多,並以H1N1為主,當地高風險族群疫苗覆蓋率僅約40%,遠低於目標(90%),當局於公共運輸點設立接種站,加強接種工作。 韓國自去年12/20發布流感流行警告,於今年第1週99.8例達高峰後下降,春季再次上升,於第15週達峰(21.6例)後持續下降,已連續3週低於閾(8.6例),宣布解除流行警告。本流感季初期以A型為主,惟今年春季後改為B型。當局表示雖已解除警告,惟仍須注意夏季可能爆發新冠疫情。
kgfiy00HE0N6tXESuY0YCg.en: São Paulo city, Brazil, reported 1,754 cases and 175 deaths from the start of this year to 11 June, up from 983 cases (77 deaths) in the same period last year. The main subtype is H1N1. Vaccination coverage in high-risk groups is only about 40%, far below the 90% target, and authorities have set up vaccination stations at public transport points to strengthen vaccination. South Korea issued an influenza epidemic warning on 20 December last year. After peaking at 99.8 in week 1 of this season, cases fell, rose again in spring, and peaked at 21.6 in week 15 before declining. Having been below the threshold of 8.6 for 3 consecutive weeks, the warning has been lifted. Influenza A predominated early in the season, but after spring it shifted to influenza B. Authorities say that although the warning has been lifted, a COVID-19 outbreak may still occur in summer.

FAbqNgLPt-7DziaUW6B5qg.zh: WHO於6/10公布風險評估報告,主要病媒為帕拉森斯庫蠓(Culicoides paraensis),其廣泛分布於美洲,疫情主要發生於亞馬遜雨林地區,2024年病例數明顯上升且持續傳播至原流行區以外地區,並首次於古巴發生疫情,且美國及歐洲部分國家亦報告境外移入病例,另巴西報告多起垂直傳染致新生兒小頭症等不良妊娠案例。人類病例主要透過病媒叮咬感染,目前尚未報告人際傳播病例,惟近期發生疑垂直感染案例,持續對其傳播機制進行研究。WHO評估於主要病媒活躍地區風險為中,存在次要病媒地區風險為低,主要病媒已知不存在地區風險為非常低。
FAbqNgLPt-7DziaUW6B5qg.en: WHO published a risk assessment on 10 June. The main vector is Culicoides paraensis, which is widely distributed in the Americas. Outbreaks have occurred mainly in the Amazon rainforest region. Case numbers rose markedly in 2024, and transmission has spread beyond the original endemic areas. An outbreak has occurred in Cuba for the first time, and some countries in the United States and Europe have reported imported cases. Brazil has reported several cases of vertical transmission leading to adverse pregnancy outcomes, including microcephaly in newborns. Human cases are mainly infected through vector bites, and no person-to-person transmission has been reported so far; recent suspected vertical transmission cases are being studied to clarify the transmission mechanism. WHO assesses the risk as moderate in areas where the main vector is active, low in areas with secondary vectors, and very low in areas where the main vector is known to be absent.

k422FmmOJ-Ac_bIIosZw6A.en: PAHO issued a pertussis epidemic alert on 31 May. Among seven countries in the Americas where case numbers are rising, the United States is the most severe, with more than 10,000 cases and 5 deaths. The others are Brazil, Mexico, Ecuador, Peru, Colombia and Paraguay, with case numbers ranging from 37 to 1,634. After peaking in 2012, case numbers in the region continued to decline, but they have risen since 2023, with 44,000 cases reported last year. The increase is associated with declining vaccination coverage during the COVID-19 pandemic. PAHO urges countries to strengthen surveillance and vaccination measures. Japan's outbreak continues: in the most recent week (19–25 May), 2,660 cases were reported, an increase of more than 360 from 2,299 the previous week, a continued high since 2018. Niigata Prefecture had the most new cases (148), followed by Hyogo Prefecture (139). So far this year, more than 22,000 cases have been reported cumulatively, and severe cases and deaths among infants have been reported. Experts say the severity of this outbreak is linked to an increase in susceptible populations: protective measures during the pandemic reduced immunity to several respiratory infectious diseases, and drug-resistant strains have continued to spread since last autumn. This year, two newborns too young to be vaccinated have died; the outbreak is concentrated among teenagers, and family members who often have contact with infants and young children at home are advised to get vaccinated.

Most cases are clade IIb men aged 30–35, distributed in the west of the country, including the capital Freetown. Outbreaks in some high-burden African countries, such as the Democratic Republic of the Congo, have slowed. The UK reported on 8 May that from October 2024 to 30 April 2025, 12 clade Ib cases had been reported cumulatively, most of which were directly or indirectly linked to travel to affected areas. Vaccination coverage in the Americas is poor: only about 30% of countries have first-dose MMR coverage above the 95% target. In addition, the COVID-19 pandemic, vaccine hesitancy and limited healthcare resources have lowered vaccination coverage and increased the number of susceptible people. This year, the disease has spread beyond that region, mainly to areas including São Paulo State in Brazil and Tolima Department in Colombia. hRTGG4qDtv1STgLktYaWXA.zh: 巴西疫情更新,今年迄今累計4,300餘例確診病例,以該國東南部瀕臨大西洋的聖埃斯皮里圖州4,000餘例病例為多;2024年累計13,700餘例確診病例,5例垂直感染病例中,有4例胎兒死亡及1例先天異常病例,另2023年共800餘例病例。
hRTGG4qDtv1STgLktYaWXA.en: Brazil update: so far this year, over 4,300 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively, more than 4,000 of them in Espírito Santo State on the Atlantic coast of the southeast. In 2024, over 13,700 confirmed cases were reported cumulatively. Of 5 cases of vertical transmission, 4 resulted in fetal death and 1 in a congenital anomaly. In 2023, over 800 cases were reported.

QifIVwH4VklXi8fVddFs4A.zh: 全球今年截至1/22累計4國報告逾5,000例病例及2例死亡,分布於美洲(3國)及歐洲(1國);2024年累計報告約62萬例病例及213例死亡,分布於美洲、亞洲、非洲及歐洲,美洲病例數以巴西42萬餘例為多,其次為巴拉圭3,100餘例,亞洲病例數以印度19萬餘例為多,其次為巴基斯坦7,300餘例。
QifIVwH4VklXi8fVddFs4A.en: Globally this year, as of 22 January, 4 countries have reported over 5,000 cases and 2 deaths cumulatively, in the Americas (3 countries) and Europe (1 country). In 2024, about 620,000 cases and 213 deaths were reported cumulatively across the Americas, Asia, Africa and Europe. In the Americas, Brazil accounted for over 420,000 cases, followed by Paraguay with over 3,100. In Asia, India accounted for over 190,000 cases, followed by Pakistan with over 7,300.

kGuc9dNyBKUB1o-NsisDgw.zh: 巴西疫情更新,聖保羅州今年迄今累計報告7例病例及3例死亡,病例主要分布於索科魯(4例)、圖尤蒂(1例)及若阿諾波利斯(1例);該州去年累計報告2例病例,當局已加強監測和疫苗接種措施。
kGuc9dNyBKUB1o-NsisDgw.en: Brazil epidemic update: So far this year, São Paulo State has cumulatively reported 7 cases and 3 deaths. Cases are mainly located in Sorocaba (4 cases), Itu (1 case) and Joanópolis (1 case); the state reported 2 cases last year. Authorities have strengthened surveillance and vaccination measures.

aLH25kT-HN5XJnUMGKPllQ.zh: 菲律賓疫情更新,該國西內羅省今年迄今累計報告250例病例及2例死亡,病例數較2024年同期63例增加297%,疫情明顯上升;該省於2024年累計6,700餘例病例及22例死亡,病例數較2023年增加354%。 巴西疫情更新,該國聖保羅州今年截至第2週累計報告約18,100例病例,其中4,340例確診,30例死亡;該州今年第1週(2024/12/29-2025/1/4)報告7,200餘例病例,高於去年同期6,500餘例。 伊朗疫情更新,該國去年累計報告逾1,000例病例,其中863例為本土病例,以南部恰巴哈爾市病例數852例為多。
aLH25kT-HN5XJnUMGKPllQ.en: Philippines epidemic update: In Negros Occidental Province, 250 cases and 2 deaths have been reported so far this year, a 297% increase over the 63 cases in the same period of 2024; the outbreak has risen markedly. In 2024 the province cumulatively reported over 6,700 cases and 22 deaths, a 354% increase in cases over 2023. Brazil epidemic update: In São Paulo State, about 18,100 cases had been reported so far this year as of week 2, of which 4,340 were confirmed and 30 died. In week 1 of this year (29 December 2024–4 January 2025), the state reported over 7,200 cases, higher than the over 6,500 in the same period last year. Iran epidemic update: Last year the country cumulatively reported over 1,000 cases, of which 863 were locally acquired; most were in Chabahar in the south, with 852 cases.

VmQLD5YRejYx8ezdM7dqmQ.zh: 多國疫情上升,病例數高於歷年同期:  亞洲:中國去(2024)年報告49萬餘例,為2023年14倍,近期疫情已趨緩,病例數已降至單月1萬例以下;韓國去年報告逾4.7萬例,今(2025)年迄今報告已逾1,600例,遠高於往年單年不超過千例水平;日本病例數持續上升,近期處高點,惟疫情仍低於新冠疫情前規模;越南去年報告1,000餘例,為2023年21.9倍。 大洋洲:澳洲於去年報告逾5.7萬例病例,為2023年23.3倍,今年初疫情持續,迄今累計報告逾3,000例;紐西蘭自去年10月中旬迄今累計報告1,200餘例,其中101例住院,1例死亡。 美洲:美國去年累計報告3.5萬餘例,為2023年同期的6倍,近期病例數呈上升趨勢;巴西去年報告逾6,000例,為2014年以來新高。
VmQLD5YRejYx8ezdM7dqmQ.en: Several countries have seen rising case numbers, above same-period levels in previous years. Asia: China reported over 490,000 cases last year (2024), 14 times the 2023 figure; the outbreak has recently eased, and monthly cases have fallen below 10,000. South Korea reported over 47,000 cases last year, and so far this year (2025) more than 1,600 cases, far above the level of previous years, when no single year exceeded 1,000 cases. Japan's case numbers continue to rise and are currently near a peak, although the outbreak remains below the scale seen before the COVID-19 pandemic. Viet Nam reported over 1,000 cases last year, 21.9 times the 2023 figure. Oceania: Australia reported over 57,000 cases last year, 23.3 times the 2023 figure; the outbreak continued into early this year, with over 3,000 cases reported so far. New Zealand has reported over 1,200 cases cumulatively since mid-October last year, of which 101 were hospitalised and 1 died. Americas: The United States reported over 35,000 cases last year, six times the same period of 2023, and case numbers are rising. Brazil reported over 6,000 cases last year, the highest since 2014.

kKjDD8D3jfeltXBd-IjQjQ.zh: 法屬留旺島疫情上升,該地區自去年8/23迄今累計報告192例病例,病例主要分布於萊唐薩萊,當局採已取防治措施,以控制疫情。 巴西疫情持續,今年截至1/17累計報告523例病例,去年累計420,000餘例病例及200餘例死亡,病例主要分布於伯南布科、聖保羅及帕拉伊巴州。
kKjDD8D3jfeltXBd-IjQjQ.en: Chikungunya cases are rising in Réunion, a French overseas territory. Since 23 August last year, 192 cases have been reported cumulatively, mainly in L'Étang-Salé, and authorities have taken prevention and control measures to contain the outbreak. Brazil's outbreak continues: so far this year (to 17 January), 523 cases have been reported cumulatively. Last year Brazil reported over 420,000 cases and over 200 deaths, mainly in Pernambuco, São Paulo and Paraíba states.

bCHcmwgzWy9mJGMKwdL2-Q.zh: 巴西疫情更新,去年累計報告6,565,716例病例及5,954例死亡,年齡分布以20-29歲為多,其次為30-39歲及40-49歲,該國之中、南部發生率較高,其中以聖保羅州病例數為多。 多明加共和國疫情更新,去年累計1,284例確診病例,較前一年下降65.54%,以該國南部聖何塞德奧科阿省之發生率最高。
bCHcmwgzWy9mJGMKwdL2-Q.en: Brazil epidemic update: Last year, 6,565,716 cases and 5,954 deaths were reported cumulatively. The age distribution is highest among people aged 20–29, followed by 30–39 and 40–49. Incidence is higher in the central and southern parts of the country, with São Paulo State reporting the most cases. Dominican Republic epidemic update: Last year, 1,284 confirmed cases were reported cumulatively, a decrease of 65.54% from the previous year. Incidence is highest in San José de Ocoa Province in the south.

jRJtBk4P9-UhQxNY3Y0SMA.zh: 巴西聖保羅州沿海自去年12月迄今腹瀉嘔吐案例上升,症狀包括噁心、嘔吐、腹瀉和腹痛,可能與污水洩漏相關,當局仍在調查感染源,並呼籲民眾洗手及避免接觸受污染之水,建議症狀嚴重時,立即就醫。
jRJtBk4P9-UhQxNY3Y0SMA.en: Cases of diarrhoea and vomiting have increased along the coast of São Paulo State, Brazil, since December last year. Symptoms include nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea and abdominal pain, and the cause may be related to sewage leakage. Authorities are still investigating the source of infection, and urge people to wash their hands and avoid contact with contaminated water. People with severe symptoms are advised to seek medical care immediately.

EI4PMHUiHdQ0XPFzGWez6w.zh: 巴西疫情更新,今年迄今累計約11,000例確診病例,分布於該國22州,以亞馬遜州及聖埃斯皮里圖州為多,病例年齡分布以20-29歲為主;聖埃斯皮里圖州另報告1例死亡個案,為61歲女性,於8/28死亡,為該國今年第4例死亡個案。
EI4PMHUiHdQ0XPFzGWez6w.en: Brazil epidemic update: So far in 2024, about 11,000 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively across 22 states, mainly Amazonas and Espírito Santo, with most patients aged 20–29. Espírito Santo State also reported one death, a 61-year-old woman who died on 28 August; this is the fourth death case in the country this year.

RKCuzrl5Ds7GFye7pzvDHQ.zh: 巴西東北部塞阿拉州12/11新增報告1例病例,為該國經檢驗確診之首例個案,病患為1歲3個月大幼童,居住於農村聚落且未曾接觸野外水源,當局已於病患家中蓄水池檢出病原,由於水源來自當地水庫,故建議水庫進行消毒,並進行病例回溯,迄無發現其他病例。
RKCuzrl5Ds7GFye7pzvDHQ.en: In Ceará State in northeastern Brazil, one case was newly reported on 11 December. It is the country's first laboratory-confirmed case of this infection, in a child aged 1 year and 3 months who lives in a rural settlement and had no contact with natural water sources. Authorities detected the pathogen in the water storage tank at the child's home. Because the water comes from a local reservoir, they recommend disinfecting the reservoir and conducting case tracing. No other cases have been found.

WtLVifwPPTUCiHAHJ-lJBQ.zh: 全球今年截至11/30累計23國報告約48萬例病例,分布於美洲、亞洲、非洲及歐洲,其中逾200例死亡;美洲病例數以巴西40萬7,000餘例為多(203例死亡),其次為巴拉圭3,000餘例;亞洲病例數以印度6萬9,000餘例為多,其次為巴基斯坦5,000餘例。 印度疫情更新,德里今年截至11/30累計226例病例,病例數為最近5年來最高。 孟加拉疫情更新,今年迄今累計67例病例,主要分布於該國首都達卡。
WtLVifwPPTUCiHAHJ-lJBQ.en: Globally, 23 countries had reported about 480,000 chikungunya cases as of 30 November this year, distributed across the Americas, Asia, Africa and Europe, with over 200 deaths. The Americas reported the most cases, with 407,000+ in Brazil (203 deaths), followed by over 3,000 in Paraguay. In Asia, India reported over 69,000 cases, followed by over 5,000 in Pakistan. India epidemic update: Delhi has recorded 226 cases so far this year as of 30 November, the highest in the past five years. Bangladesh epidemic update: 67 cases have been reported so far this year, mainly in the capital, Dhaka.

jnF9JaU_cVPnKzWYGT9N6A.zh: 越南疫情更新,胡志明市於近10週病例數持續上升,最近1週報告約700例病例,已有1例死亡,今年迄今累計已逾12,000例惟較去年同期為低。 巴西疫情更新,今年截至11月已累計逾600萬例(疑)病例及5,086例死亡,該國今年病例數已為1986年以來最高,其中以米納斯吉拉斯州最為嚴峻。
jnF9JaU_cVPnKzWYGT9N6A.en:
Viet Nam update: In Ho Chi Minh City, case numbers have kept rising over the past 10 weeks, with about 700 cases reported in the latest week and 1 death so far. Cumulative cases this year exceed 12,000, which is lower than the same period last year.

Brazil update: As of November this year, more than 6 million (suspected) cases and 5,086 deaths have been cumulatively reported. The country's case count this year is already the highest since 1986, with Minas Gerais State the most severely affected.

btV44USRJogTjiwRdKcwOQ.zh: 巴西疫情更新,今年截至11月累計逾26萬例病例,病例數分布以該國東南部米納斯吉拉斯為多,該國今年截至8月累計159例死亡,已高於去年全年之122例死亡數。
btV44USRJogTjiwRdKcwOQ.en: Brazil update: As of November this year, more than 260,000 cases have been cumulatively reported, with most cases in Minas Gerais in the southeast of the country. As of August this year, 159 deaths have been cumulatively reported, already exceeding last year's full-year total of 122 deaths.

5Le7wF2JlCuYzShdrD6Bzg.zh: 美洲疫情更新,今年截至11/25累計11,634例病例,其中2例死亡均來自巴西,共11國/地區報告病例,分別為巴西(9,563)、秘魯(936)、古巴(603)、玻利維亞(356)、哥倫比亞(74)、厄瓜多(2)、蓋亞那(2)及巴拿馬(1)。另美國(94)、加拿大(2)及英屬開曼群島(1)亦報告病例,皆為境外移入病例;此外,巴西已報告垂直感染確診病例。WHO評估該病毒對區域的公共衛生風險為高,對全球的風險為低。
5Le7wF2JlCuYzShdrD6Bzg.en: Americas update: As of 25 November this year, 11,634 cases have been cumulatively reported, including 2 deaths, both from Brazil. A total of 11 countries/territories have reported cases: Brazil (9,563), Peru (936), Cuba (603), Bolivia (356), Colombia (74), Ecuador (2), Guyana (2) and Panama (1). The United States (94), Canada (2) and the British overseas territory of the Cayman Islands (1) have also reported cases, all of them imported. In addition, Brazil has reported confirmed cases of vertical transmission. WHO assesses the public health risk of the virus as high for the region and low for the world.

Ky6NgSO8pogCLWfWe_GsIw.zh: 巴西南部巴拉那州今年截至11月累計報告39例病例,為去年同期之1.9倍;玻利維亞中部科恰班巴省10月底至11月初新增2例死亡病例,當局已發布流行病學警報。
Ky6NgSO8pogCLWfWe_GsIw.en: In Paraná State in southern Brazil, 39 cases have been reported this year as of November, 1.9 times the same period last year. In Cochabamba Department in central Bolivia, 2 deaths were newly reported between late October and early November, and authorities have issued an epidemiological alert.

ZLJv8x-qaOcEt2G-exalFA.zh: 美洲疫情更新,加拿大安大略省10月初新增1例死亡案例,病患為兒童並曾接觸蝙蝠,當地蝙蝠帶原比例有升高跡象,當局呼籲民眾與蝙蝠接觸後,無論是否有傷痕,均應就醫治療;巴西托坎廷斯州10月底新增1例病例,暴露情形未敘明,當局已前往調查帶原動物。 亞洲疫情更新,越南同奈省、廣南省分別於9、10月新增1例死亡病例,均係經狗咬傷且未接種疫苗,該國狂犬病發病後死亡率為100%;菲律賓北達沃省10月底新增1例死亡病例,病患曾食用狗肉,當局已啟動追蹤共同暴露者。
ZLJv8x-qaOcEt2G-exalFA.en:
Americas update: In Ontario, Canada, 1 death was newly reported in early October. The patient was a child who had had contact with bats. The proportion of bats carrying rabies in the area appears to be rising. Authorities urge anyone who has had contact with bats to seek medical treatment, regardless of whether there are wounds. In Tocantins State, Brazil, 1 new case was reported in late October; the exposure circumstances were not stated, and authorities have gone to investigate rabies-carrying animals.

Asia update: In Dong Nai and Quang Nam provinces, Viet Nam, 1 death each was newly reported in September and October respectively. Both patients had been bitten by dogs and were unvaccinated. The case fatality rate of rabies in Viet Nam once symptoms develop is 100%. In Davao del Norte Province, Philippines, 1 death was newly reported in late October; the patient had eaten dog meat, and authorities have begun tracing people with shared exposure.

yS6IQ5shKM7ev5YL1T8byQ.zh: 哥倫比亞疫情更新,今年截至11/7累計26例病例,主要分布於該國中西部托利馬省,當局已實施疫苗接種措施。今年截至第35週美洲區已報告38例確診病例,其中19例死亡,疫情主要分布於哥倫比亞、玻利維亞、秘魯、巴西及蓋亞那。
yS6IQ5shKM7ev5YL1T8byQ.en: Colombia update: As of 7 November this year, 26 cases have been cumulatively reported, mainly in Tolima Department in west-central Colombia, and authorities have implemented vaccination measures. As of week 35 this year, the Region of the Americas has reported 38 confirmed cases, including 19 deaths. Cases are mainly distributed in Colombia, Bolivia, Peru, Brazil and Guyana.

unoWzrixICQQwjn7hG4dqw.zh: 全球疫情更新,今年迄今累計超過1,300萬例病例及8,500例死亡:  美洲區病例數以巴西為多,其次為阿根廷、墨西哥、巴拉圭、哥倫比亞; 歐洲區法國、義大利、西班牙有報告病例; 東地中海區伊朗、阿富汗、巴基斯坦有報告病例; 東南亞區孟加拉及泊爾病例數上升,印度喀拉拉邦及卡納塔卡邦今年病例數高於去年同期,印病例數下降; 西太平洋區中國及越南病例數上升,柬埔寨病例數下降; 非洲區中非共和國於9月中公布爆發疫情,多哥疫情亦上升。
unoWzrixICQQwjn7hG4dqw.en:
Global update: So far this year, more than 13 million cases and 8,500 deaths have been cumulatively reported globally.

Americas: Case numbers are highest in Brazil, followed by Argentina, Mexico, Paraguay and Colombia.

Europe: France, Italy and Spain have reported cases.

Eastern Mediterranean: Iran, Afghanistan and Pakistan have reported cases.

South-East Asia: Case numbers rose in Bangladesh and Nepal. In the Indian states of Kerala and Karnataka, cases this year are higher than in the same period last year. Case numbers in Indonesia declined.

Western Pacific: Case numbers rose in China and Viet Nam and fell in Cambodia.

Africa: The Central African Republic announced an outbreak in mid-September, and cases in Togo also rose.

KGsMtpD5lCJcXtlohtztbw.zh: 美洲疫情更新,今年1-9月累計1萬餘例病例,其中2例死亡均來自巴西,共9國報告病例,分別為巴西(8,258)、秘魯(936)、古巴(555)、玻利維亞(356)、哥倫比亞(74)、厄瓜多(2)及蓋亞那(2),另美國(90)及加拿大(2)亦報告病例,皆為境外移入病例。
KGsMtpD5lCJcXtlohtztbw.en: Americas update: From January to September this year, more than 10,000 cases have been cumulatively reported, including 2 deaths, both in Brazil. A total of 9 countries reported cases: Brazil (8,258), Peru (936), Cuba (555), Bolivia (356), Colombia (74), Ecuador (2) and Guyana (2). The United States (90) and Canada (2) also reported cases, all of them imported.

st4YT_kiZKMml4ANct7HAw.zh: 全球今年截至9/30累計23國報告約46萬例病例,分布於美洲、亞洲、非洲及歐洲,其中170例死亡均來自巴西;美洲病例數以巴西391,000餘例為多,其次為巴拉圭2,000餘例;亞洲病例數以印度69,000餘例為多,其次為巴基斯坦2,000餘例。
st4YT_kiZKMml4ANct7HAw.en: Globally this year as of 30 September, 23 countries have reported about 460,000 cases cumulatively across the Americas, Asia, Africa and Europe, and all 170 deaths were in Brazil. In the Americas, cases are highest in Brazil with over 391,000, followed by Paraguay with over 2,000. In Asia, cases are highest in India with over 69,000, followed by Pakistan with over 2,000.
